summary: Cellular-automata cave generation. A reference implementation with four knobs.
overview: Seeds a grid with walls at a fill probability, then smooths it repeatedly with the classic 4-5 rule: a cell becomes wall if five or more of its eight neighbours are walls. Deliberately a REFERENCE implementation — grid size, fill probability, iterations and seed are the only settings, so the algorithm stays readable.
useCases: Organic cave or cavern layouts for a roguelike.
A starting point to adapt rather than a finished generator.
Learning how cellular-automata generation actually behaves by changing one knob at a time.

gotchas.title: It can produce disconnected pockets
gotchas.body: The 4-5 rule smooths shapes, it does not guarantee everything is reachable. Connectivity is a separate pass you have to add.

gotchas.title: Fill probability is far more sensitive than it looks
gotchas.body: A few percent either side of the usual 45 is the difference between open caverns and near-solid rock.
